research_question: Can a causal evidence-gated transition policy improve temporal stability in online surgical phase recognition while preserving frame-level performance and transition sensitivity?

method_source.name: Evidence-Gated Transition Predictor
method_source.citation: Liu et al., Stabilizing Temporal Inference Dynamics for Online Surgical Phase Recognition, arXiv:2605.16387v1, 2026
method_source.implementation_note: The paper does not define single-observation and zero-variance numerical handling. This project freezes initial_std=1.0, population Welford running standard deviation, and std_floor=1e-6.

initial_stage.description: Apply EGTP to the frozen baseline LSTM without retraining.

single_controlled_optimisation.description: Add the paper-derived TEC training loss, then re-evaluate the same EGTP protocol on validation.

egtp.candidate_range_rationale: The fixed grid includes the paper's AutoLaparo k=0.8 and the reported AutoLaparo best values 0.6 and 0.8, with symmetric local sensitivity coverage. The list is frozen before computing new validation metrics.

operating_point_selection.reference: original frozen baseline raw argmax for the same training seed
operating_point_selection.if_strict_exists: select maximum three-seed mean boundary_f1_tol10; ties select smaller k
operating_point_selection.if_no_strict_but_basic_exists: select k_F1 and k_recall; final comparison uses k_F1 and k_recall is supplementary
operating_point_selection.if_basic_empty: constraint_failure; report best boundary F1 descriptively only
operating_point_selection.final_variant_rule: Choose the valid variant at the highest available feasibility layer with maximum mean boundary_f1_tol10; ties prefer higher mean macro_f1, then uncalibrated probabilities, then the smaller k.

change_control: Any change after validation evaluation requires a new protocol version. Test evaluation begins only after a versioned final selection record is written.
